## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one logical change
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] Example runs against the documented API surface at [textconvo.ai/docs](https://textconvo.ai/docs)
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens, phone numbers, customer data, or personal data
- [ ] No platform implementation, orchestration logic, or infrastructure detail introduced
- [ ] Reference documentation was linked rather than duplicated
- [ ] Errors are handled explicitly in any new sample code
- [ ] README or docs updated if behaviour or usage changed
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/textconvo/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
